name: Praemium Limited
summary: Praemium Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides advisors and wealth management solutions in Australia. It offers products, such as Sprectrum, SMA, Super, Scope, and Scope+ solutions. The company also provides platforms, including reporting, digital experience, data integration, customizations, tax optimization, and alternative assets. Praemium Limited was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Melbourne, Australia.
